summary.intent: Execute GSD phase 68.1 (wiring CipherBox's web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain) end-to-end through wave-based execution, multiple gap-closure rounds, and a full ship-phase workflow (verify/secure/validate/simplify/SDK-E2E/CodeRabbit/PR), then support live manual smoke-testing of the shipped branch.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 fully executed across 33 plans and 3 verification rounds (final: passed 5/5), shipped as PR #588 with all CI checks green and MERGEABLE; manual smoke testing afterward surfaced and fixed several real bugs (move write-link orphaning, CAS-merge write-body clobber, dropped duplicate-folder-name check) plus found one new unresolved bug (owner sees stale empty shared-out folder after a write-grantee uploads) filed as a todo but not yet fixed.

repo: Write plane is keyed by node UUID (childId/WriteChildRef), read plane by ipnsName (SealedChildRef) — mixing these up is the root cause of several bugs this session (move re-homing, shared subfolder resolution).

publishWithCas / CAS-merge on a 409 must merge BOTH the read-body and write-body — a real shipping bug had it resealing the write-body from a stale closure value, silently dropping a concurrent writer's WriteChildRef.
D-09 zeroization rule: only the terminal owner of a key buffer zeros it; a callee must never zero a caller-owned buffer (violating this previously broke 48/89 e2e tests).

D-03: getWriteBodyParams fail-opens to {} / [] on a zero/unresolvable writeKey — intentional but has a latent risk: a transient IPNS resolve miss on an already write-capable folder can seal an empty write-body, dropping the whole write chain (duplicated in client.ts and bin/index.ts).
CI's unit-test job does NOT run apps/web tests at all (web is covered only by Playwright web-e2e) — a broken web unit test/mock can silently rot on main without CI going red.
CodeRabbit CLI has a 150-file diff cap; large phase diffs must be split into directory-scoped review passes (--dir apps/packages/tests).

mock-ipns-routing (local dev delegated-routing mock) keeps records in an in-memory Map wiped on every container restart — records without a synchronously-written ipns_records DB row die permanently on restart.

Email OTP dev-mode console logging in EmailOtpService only fires when NODE_ENV === 'development' || unset; running the API under the e2e env (NODE_ENV=test/production) silently suppresses the log even though the OTP is generated and hashed into Redis.

Folder store seeds newly-created folders as isLoaded:true with empty children (useFolderMutations.ts) and both the web nav cache and SDK's ensureFolderLoaded take a fast-path that skips re-resolving IPNS for already-loaded folders — combined with the 30s poll only re-resolving root, this means an owner never sees a collaborator's shared-write uploads until they themselves write into that folder or hard-reload.
resyncFolder exists in the codebase but has zero call sites — dead code that could have addressed the stale-snapshot class of bugs.
1Password SSH commit signing frequently produces false-negative timeouts (exit 143) even though the commit lands — always verify via `git log -1` before retrying, never blind-retry.
Web3Auth Core Kit login has a known external flake signature ("Failed to get vault keypair from Core Kit", init hangs) — isolable via single-file spec re-run, not a code bug.

code.finding: decodeRemote never unsealed the remote write-body on a 409 CAS conflict, and merge only unioned read-body children — write-body was resealed from stale closure writeChildren, dropping a concurrent writer's WriteChildRef. Fixed by unsealing remote write-body and unioning writeChildren by childId (add-only, remote wins).

moveItem re-linked the read-plane SealedChildRef on move but left the moved item's WriteChildRef orphaned in the source write-body, permanently breaking edit/save after move into a subfolder — this matched the user's live repro. Fixed by unsealing under source writeKey, dropping from source, resealing under dest writeKey, keyed by resolved node UUID (not the ipnsName-based moveItem childId param).

buildSharedWriteContextFromState deliberately excludes ipnsPrivateKey — shared writes recover the real IPNS signing key from the unsealed write-body via state.writeKey (~line 3730 unsealNode), so a Greptile finding claiming write shares lose their signing key was invalid (dead vestigial all-zero-key seed path, not a live signing bug).

navigateUp only re-derives the real writeKey when isRootDepth is true; navigating up/via-breadcrumb to a deeper subfolder in a nested write-share restores it with writeKey undefined, so writes from that restored level fail 'not write-capable' until re-entering from the share root. Real bug, deferred (not fixed at ship time) due to zeroization-lifecycle risk and missing e2e coverage.

Newly created folders are seeded with isLoaded:true and empty children in the store — combined with cached-fast-path navigation and root-only polling, this is why an owner never sees a collaborator's writes into a shared-out folder without their own write or a reload.
createFolder was missing the duplicate-name rejection that uploadFile still enforced — a v2→v3 cutover regression, confirmed and fixed by mirroring uploadFile's check.

workflow: GSD wave-based execute-phase keeps the orchestrator lean (~15% context) by dispatching each plan to a fresh subagent in an isolated worktree, recording worktree metadata, merging, then running post-merge typecheck+scoped-vitest gates before the next wave.

Long-running background agents (especially ones that launch a multi-minute e2e suite and then wait) reliably suffer a 'lost wake' failure mode — the agent parks itself waiting on its own background shell and is never re-invoked when it completes. Mitigation: an independent disk-based watchdog (e.g. watching a results file) plus prompt-based SendMessage resumption while the transcript is still warm; if the transcript is evicted, spawn a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed-state context.
Exit-gate/checkpoint plans marked autonomous:false must get real human sign-off via AskUserQuestion for gap dispositions — never self-approve even under auto_advance config.

When rebuilding a client SDK chain (crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→api) mid-session, both the API process and any Vite dev server must be restarted afterward — Vite caches the pre-rebuild dist and a stale API instance may be running under a different .env (e.g. E2E env vars that suppress dev-only logging).

Session/credit exhaustion can kill an agent mid-task; recovery requires inspecting the actual disk state (uncommitted diffs, partial edits) rather than trusting the last returned summary, then completing the aborted work inline or re-spawning.
CodeRabbit PR-level review can silently skip when the diff exceeds its file cap — always check for a 'skipped' state and fall back to a local directory-scoped CLI pass before relying on it as a gate.
Greptile (second PR reviewer) can raise new findings on its re-review of your own fix commits — always re-poll reviewThreads after pushing before declaring 0 unresolved.

friction: Multiple background agents died mid-task on account session/credit limits (Fable 5 exhaustion, then a later Claude session-limit reset), requiring manual disk-state recovery and re-spawning rather than trusting agent self-reports.

Exit-gate/executor agents repeatedly lost their wake-up after launching long background e2e runs, requiring independent watchdogs and prompt-based resumption workarounds multiple times across the session.
Two executor subagents ran a forbidden `git stash` mid-task (against explicit project rules); both were caught and manually reverted/dropped without data loss, but required orchestrator vigilance.
CodeRabbit's PR-level review was skipped twice (locally at 179/207 files vs its 150-file cap), forcing manual directory-scoped local runs to get equivalent coverage.

OTP extraction was blocked for several turns because the API instance answering requests was running under leftover E2E environment variables (NODE_ENV suppressing the dev-only OTP log) rather than a plain dev config.

A stale Vite dev server (started hours before the final SDK rebuild) was silently serving pre-fix client code, which would have invalidated a smoke test had it not been caught and restarted with forced dependency re-optimization.

CI's Test job failed on a stale `shares.controller.spec.ts` assertion (expected 4 args vs the actual 6-arg write-descriptor delegation) — an out-of-session-scope regression that still had to be fixed to get the gate green.

A pre-existing, unrelated `ipns.service.test.ts` module-load crash (stale api-client mock) had to be carefully triaged to confirm it predated the branch and wasn't CI-gating, to avoid scope creep into an unrelated fix.
open_items: PR #588 is green/MERGEABLE but not yet merged — merge decision left to the user.

Nested write-share loses write capability when navigating up/via-breadcrumb to an intermediate subfolder (writeKey not re-derived except at share root) — documented as a known non-blocker with a workaround (re-enter from share root), tracked as a todo.

New bug found in final smoke test: an owner does not see a write-grantee's uploads into a shared-out folder until they themselves write or hard-reload (stale isLoaded:true empty-children snapshot + cached-fast-path nav + root-only polling) — filed as todo `2026-07-04-owner-stale-empty-snapshot-shared-out-folder.md`, not fixed.
Recovery tool (`recovery.html`) still only supports legacy v2 vault blobs vs the v3/node-v3 format shipped since Phase 62 — needs its own port plan.
rotation-durability SC-4 residual: the API's DB-canonical resolve makes the relay-replay scenario test-unreachable — needs an apps/api architectural decision or test redesign.
restore-to-different-parent write re-homing shares the same bug class as the fixed move-write-link issue but on an unshipped flow — deferred.

~17 other follow-up todos filed during ship-phase covering: sdk-e2e quarantine sweep completion, dedupe sdk write-plane helpers, consolidate web shared-navigation duplication, hoist base64ToBytes into crypto package, remove legacy moveInSharedFolder share_keys branch, drop discarded per-upload ECIES wrapKey, download-progress UX decision, getWriteBodyParams transient-resolve-miss write-chain drop, delete-should-drop-WriteChildRef (currently retained), rename ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted field, fix broken ipns.service unit test mock, remove dead getShareKeys folder-ipns path, and shared-nav-stack stale-children snapshot.
